name: Onu
summary: Barithras Moonshade sends you south from Auberdine to speak with Onu. Your findings in Cliffspring Falls have drawn the attention of one of Darkshore's oldest guardians.

sections.title: A Summons from the Ancients
sections.body: Barithras Moonshade sees more than strange fungi in the samples you brought back to Auberdine. The caves beneath Cliffspring Falls are tainted, and word of them reaches Onu, an Ancient of Lore in the Grove of the Ancients south of town. The corruption in Darkshore's waterways may reach beyond anything a naturalist can explain. Onu wants counsel, and even an Ancient's patient nature cannot hide the weight of that summons.

sections.title: Journey to the Grove
sections.body: The road south from Auberdine turns inland, away from the coastal ruins and toward the mountain slopes. The Grove of the Ancients shelters an old refuge of nature, set apart from the decay along the shore. Onu waits among stone barrows and kindred spirits, ready to guide allies toward the blights stirring at the edge of the wilderness.

faq.answer: Onu is an Ancient of Lore, a great tree guardian who gathers and preserves knowledge. He watches over the Grove of the Ancients in southern Darkshore and offers wisdom to those defending the land.

faq.q: Why does Onu want to speak with me?
faq.answer: You gathered fungal samples for Barithras Moonshade from the caves beneath Cliffspring Falls. What you found alarmed the naturalists, and Onu wants to speak with you about the spreading corruption.

faq.q: Where is the Grove of the Ancients?
aliases: where is grove of the ancients
faq.answer: The Grove of the Ancients lies south of Auberdine, along the eastern mountain foothills. Follow the main road south through Darkshore, then head east toward the mountain slopes to reach Onu.

faq.q: What kind of creature is an Ancient of Lore?
faq.answer: Ancients of Lore are old treant beings allied with the night elves and the Cenarion Circle. They are revered for their wisdom and memory, and preserve nature's magic and history.

faq.q: Why is Onu's summons considered urgent?
faq.answer: Ancients are deliberate and rarely hurry. Barithras Moonshade says Onu's call for counsel means the threat to Darkshore is severe.

faq.q: What comes after meeting with Onu?
faq.answer: After you meet Onu at the Grove of the Ancients, he asks for your help investigating a darker threat farther south along the coast: the excavation around the Master's Glaive.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know the Ancients of Lore as sacred partners who have guided your people since before the Sundering. Answering Onu's call helps preserve Darkshore.
As a druid, you revere the Ancients as keepers of nature's wisdom. Investigating the strange growths in the caves at Onu's request fits the Cenarion Circle's work.
As an Alliance traveler helping defend Darkshore, you can turn to the region's Ancients for insight into Kalimdor's northern wilderness.
